lessons.trigger_condition: a verified candidate generation has merged to main, then a later pull request with no new watched-path changes is compared from the older delta source and incorrectly re-reports already-covered watched changes as stale
lessons.prevention_rule: after a verified candidate merge, create a post-merge checkpoint generation anchored to that exact main SHA before treating later pull requests as current; do not weaken watched-path freshness or reuse the candidate base as a permanent source anchor
validation_required: source_main_sha equals the exact post-merge main SHA
covered merge #310 is an ancestor of the current head
delta/receipt lesson digest and IDs match canonically
later watched-path changes still fail closed and require a newer delta
lessons.safety_boundary: checkpoint metadata must not claim physical tablet or Drive verification and must never export secrets, model weights, raw grading calibration, or overwrite device-local learning
